owner_instruction: Push builds to me every new build you complete
scope: Resumed previously approved APD development. Build, verify and deliver each completed Developer/Alpha-Testers pair through the existing private GitHub release route, with version and download links. No new game design or balance changes.

verification_required: Actual core/native results, manual affected-window review, original signing identity, source and hashes. Retain failed candidates and their evidence.
